principle_violations.reason: The VolumeCalculator class is inheriting from AreaCalculator but implements a sum method that calculates volume, thus mixing area and volume calculations within one class.
principle_violations.suggestion: Separate the volume calculation logic into a dedicated class, possibly named VolumeCalculator, and avoid extending AreaCalculator when the context of the operation diverges.

principle_violations.reason: The VolumeCalculator is directly modifying the behavior of the AreaCalculator and expects the shapes to have a common method for area calculation instead of having a specific interface for volume.
principle_violations.suggestion: Introduce specific interfaces for different types of shapes (e.g., area, volume) and ensure that the VolumeCalculator can handle those shapes without needing to change its code.
